# Northgate

Find the risk before the auditor does

Northgate scans your cloud accounts continuously and shows the five things that actually matter this week.

## Features

### Continuous scanning

Every account, every region, every hour.

### Ranked by blast radius

Fix what would hurt, not what is noisy.

### Evidence exports

One click to the report your auditor wants.

## Who it is for

Security teams.

## Pricing

Starts free. Team plans from $29 per month.
